channel.description: Aggregated rainfall, thunderstorm, and special forecasts from PAGASA NCRPRSD

item.title: Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Rainfall Advisory No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shearline / Easterlies
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 20 November 2026(Friday)

Light to moderate rains are expected over Rizal(Tanay), Laguna(Santa Maria, Siniloan, Famy, Pangil, Pakil, Paete, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, Luisiana, Mabitac, Majayjay), Bulacan(Norzagaray, Dona Remedios Trinidad) and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gabaldon, Carranglan, Pantabangan, Bongabon, Laur).

Light to moderate rains affecting Quezon(Burdeos, Panukulan, Polillo, Patnanungan, Jomalig) and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to www.pagasa.dost.gov.ph.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCRPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #NCR_PRSD
Issued at: 12:30 PM, 19 November 2026(Thursday)

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over Laguna (Paete, Kalayaan, Lumban, Cavinti, and Luisiana) and Quezon (Mauban, Sampaloc, Real, Infanta, General Nakar, Polillo, Burdeos, Panukulan, Patnanungan, and Jomalig) within the next 2 hours.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
